notes.title: Slope flying in Stryn
notes.notes:
Excursion time. We will travel a few hours north and jump from the Mårsahyrna mountain in Stryn, Norway, next to the Oppstrynsvatnet lake.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35065028/921169e935465b7d61bf96cfe9506387aaeac1c8.jpg[/img]

This is the first bonus level added. It has it's own set of challenges, but they will not count towards completion stats.
Let us know if you like it or not.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35065028/1529614f91cfd12cf61c4659b8c46e44d85de49e.jpg[/img]

We have also made some adjustments to the plane objectives and made it faster to retry objectives.

Happy flying!

notes.title: Time to hit the sky in Wingsuit: Gudvangen
notes.notes:
Some say the extreme sport genre is dead, and this is where we prove them wrong. Wingsuit: Gudvangen is finally ready for release, and it's a breath of fresh air.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35065028/bd94a49dde43b89f36f99b22305bf677daea58e3.jpg[/img]

Part open world wingsuit BASE jumping simulator, part spiritual successor to the THPS franchise, it provides a furiously fast and focused flying experience without taking itself too seriously. There are huge spaces for you to explore in this faithful recreation of the classic BASE jumping location, lots of collectibles to look for, and the sky is your skill ceiling when it comes to pulling sick flips while carving perfect lines down the mountainside. Fans of Mount Wingsuit will know what we're talking about.
